note: WAEC Literature round 2 (Round 19 lift): catharsis, static character, symbolism, objective narration, complication, external conflict, euphony, bathos, syntax; protagonist, prologue, epilogue, melodrama, cast; anti-hero, motif, intercalary story, physical setting; Shakespearean couplet, caesura, couplet, ballad, Soyinka's Abiku, Okigbo's Labyrinths, Osundare; negritude-Senghor, No Longer at Ease (Obi), Arrow of God (Ezeulu), A Man of the People, The Concubine (Ihuoma), Sozaboy (Mene), Death and the King's Horseman (Elesin), The Lion and the Jewel (Sidi, Lakunle, Ilujinle), Anthills pairing; Achebe's purpose, Soyinka's Yoruba roots, theme-spotting, allegory. Scanned against WAEC r1, NECO rounds 1-2 and all banks.
